pages.title: Male & Female
pages.text: Every animal is randomly assigned a gender at birth: 50% male, 50% female.$(br2)Males are slightly larger (110%~120% size), while females are a bit smaller (90%~100%).$(br2)You can see the gender by looking at the animal with Jade installed.
Male sheep are visibly bigger. Gender matters for breeding — only a male and a female can produce offspring.
